items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a couple of things with him.

ctx.x: Yes and they seem to overlap with Oscar Pettiford.

Well, Oscar was involved with a lot of it. Oscar did a lot of dates his own group as well. Oscar was always in demand to play with other groups. He was such a fantastic bass player. He was always, like I said, and demand. If you could get Oscar, you were really ahead of the game. He was always busy. I did a couple of things with him. He also recorded with strings at Birdland. But, I’m getting away from GG Grice thing.
It seems that this was a… First of all, a lot of this music is almost forgotten.
